Netanyahu faces political crisis in Israel as opposition seeks Arab party support

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing a political crisis as the opposition seeks to form a government and remove him from power. Reports indicate that opposition parties are considering allying with Arab parties to achieve this goal. There are suggestions that Arab parties' lawmakers might "betray" Netanyahu, potentially leading to a change in power.
